title: HUNTR/X & Saja Boys Shrink to Collectible Form in New ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Little People Collector Set
summary: The new merch puts the fan-favorite characters in the palm of your hand.
contentText:

KPop Demon Hunters fans have a new collectible to add to their collection with the release of the official HUNTR/X and Saja Boys Little People Collector Sets.

Part of the popular Fisher-Price series of miniaturized pop culture figures , which has previously featured everyone from the Backstreet Boys to RuPaul , the new sets put the fan-favorite characters from KPop Demon Hunters in the palm of your hand.

NEW RELEASE

Little People Collector KPop Demon Hunters: HUNTR/X Special Edition Set

$21.59

Buy Now On Amazon

The HUNTR/X set re-imagines Rumi, Mira and Zoey as 2.5-inch plastic figures, with each member of the girl group styled in their signature looks from the film.

Lead singer Rumi stands on a gold podium in the center with her long purple braid, while lead rapper Zoey shows off her “buns” hairstyle. Mira completes the trio with her fuschia hair and matching hot pink makeup.

The three figurines are displayed in a collectible box inspired by their hit single “Golden,” and designed to resemble a performance stage.

ALSO AVAILABLE

​Little People Collector KPop Demon Hunters: Saja Boys Special Edition Set

$29.97 $32.39 7% off

The Saja Boys set features the five boy band members standing in front of a “Soda Pop”-inspired set.

Little details abound, like Abby’s Hawaiian shirt and chiseled abs, and Mystery’s shaggy hair. Lead singer Jinu, meanwhile, is styled in a white checkered shirt, blue jeans and pink belt, just like in the movie. The Saja Boys mini plastic figures also stand 2.5 inches tall.

Just like the HUNTR/X set, fans can choose to take the figurines out of the box, or keep them inside for an easy display piece. The KPop Demon Hunters Little People Collector Sets are the latest merch and toy release from the hit Netflix film, which has become the streaming service’s most streamed title of all time.

Find the KPop Demon Hunters x Fisher-Price collab on Amazon . The collectible figurines are sure to sell quickly, so we recommend adding to cart while the sets are still in stock.
